legal_notice_description: This app is provided by the Stiftung Deutschland im Plus to support people in financial education and over-indebtedness prevention.
privacy_intro: The protection of your personal data is a particular concern of ours. We therefore process your personal data (in short 'data') exclusively on the basis of legal regulations. With this privacy policy, we want to inform you comprehensively about the processing of your data in our company and the data protection claims and rights to which you are entitled within the meaning of Art. 13 of the European General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR).

privacy_sec_2_title: What data is processed and from what sources does this data originate?
privacy_sec_2_intro: Within the app, we enable you to retrieve and display the following information:
privacy_sec_2_list_item_3: Import/export function for entries, accounts, etc.
privacy_sec_2_usage_intro: When you use the app, we process your personal data. Personal data is understood to be all information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person. Because the protection of your privacy when using the app is important to us, we would like to inform you with the following information about which personal data we process when you use the app and how we handle this data. In addition, we inform you about the legal basis for processing your data and, to the extent that processing is necessary to safeguard our legitimate interests, also about our legitimate interests.
privacy_sec_2_access_policy: You can access this privacy policy at any time under the 'Privacy' menu item in the app.
privacy_sec_3_title: Information on the processing of your data
privacy_sec_3_intro: Certain information is already processed automatically as soon as you use the app. Exactly which personal data is processed is listed for you below:
privacy_sec_3_download_text: When downloading the app, certain required information is transmitted to the app store you selected (e.g. Google Play or Apple App Store); in particular, the username, email address, customer number of your account, download time, payment information, and the individual device identification number can be processed. The processing of this data is carried out exclusively by the respective App Store and is beyond our control.
privacy_sec_3_auto_text: No data is collected automatically when you use the app.
privacy_sec_3_reg_text: Creation of a user account (registration) to use the online function of our app. When you create a user account or log in, we use your access data (entered name, email address) to grant you access to your user account ('mandatory details'). If you do not provide this data, you cannot create a user account and therefore cannot use the online function.
privacy_sec_3_usage_text: Within the app, you can manually enter your name, name accounts, make entries for income/expenses, and set savings goals or limits. However, these entries are saved exclusively offline on your own device and are not transmitted.
privacy_sec_3_online_text: Internet access is required to use the online function of the app. This enables logging in and syncing across multiple devices, as well as 'sharing' the created accounts with other co-users (members).
privacy_sec_3_justification_text: This data processing is justified by our legitimate interest in ensuring the functionality and error-free operation of the app, which overrides your rights and interests in protecting your personal data within the meaning of Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. f) GDPR.
privacy_sec_3_survey_title: Data processing within the framework of the user survey
privacy_sec_3_survey_text_1: Within the framework of the user survey, we ask questions about your person and your usage of the app 'Mein Budget – Ausgaben im Griff'. The aim of our survey is to better evaluate the benefit of our app and to derive optimization potential according to the needs of our users.
privacy_sec_3_survey_text_2: No personal data is collected in the survey. The data collected based on the survey does not allow any conclusions to be drawn about identified or identifiable natural persons.
privacy_sec_3_survey_text_3: Neither your name nor registration is required to participate in the survey. Participation in the survey is voluntary, and the survey can be discontinued at any time.
privacy_sec_3_survey_text_4: The non-personal data is stored for the purpose and duration of the survey. It is deleted after evaluating the results.
privacy_sec_4_title: Am I obliged to provide data?
privacy_sec_4_text: The processing of your data is necessary to provide the app and its functions. If you do not make this data available to us, you will no longer be able to use certain functions of the app at all or only to a limited extent.
privacy_sec_5_text_1: We rely on contractually bound external service providers to perform our service:
privacy_sec_5_text_2: Any transfer of personal data is justified by the fact that we have carefully selected, regularly reviewed, and contractually bound our external companies and service providers as processors in the context of Art. 28 Para. 1 GDPR to process all personal data exclusively in accordance with our instructions.
privacy_sec_5_text_3: If it is necessary to investigate unlawful or abusive use of the app or for legal prosecution, personal data will be forwarded to law enforcement agencies or other authorities and, if applicable, to injured third parties or legal advisors. However, this only happens if there are indications of unlawful or abusive behavior. Transfer can also take place if this serves the enforcement of terms of use or other legal claims. We are also legally obliged to provide information to certain public bodies upon request. These are law enforcement authorities, authorities pursuing administrative offenses, and tax authorities.
privacy_sec_5_text_4: Any transfer of personal data is justified by the processing being necessary to fulfill a legal obligation to which we are subject under Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. c) GDPR in conjunction with national legal provisions for passing data to law enforcement agencies, or we have a legitimate interest in passing the data to the aforementioned third parties if there are indications of abusive behavior or legal claims, and your rights and interests in protecting your personal data within the meaning of Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. f) GDPR do not override.
privacy_sec_5_text_5: As part of the further development of our business, it may happen that the structure of our company changes, by changing the legal form, or by establishing, buying, or selling subsidiaries, parts of the company, or components. In such transactions, customer information may be passed on together with the part of the company to be transferred. Whenever personal data is passed on to third parties to the extent described above, we ensure that this is done in accordance with this privacy policy and applicable data protection law.
privacy_sec_5_text_6: Any transfer of personal data is justified by our legitimate interest in adapting our corporate structure to economic and legal circumstances as required, and your rights and interests in protecting your personal data within the meaning of Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. f) GDPR do not override.
privacy_sec_6_title: How long is my data stored?
privacy_sec_6_text: We process your data until the end of the cooperation or until the expiration of applicable statutory retention periods (such as from the Commercial Code, the Fiscal Code, or the Working Hours Act); furthermore, until the conclusion of any legal disputes in which the data is required as evidence.
privacy_sec_7_title: Is personal data transferred to a third country?
privacy_sec_7_text: In principle, no data is transferred by us to a third country.
privacy_sec_8_text_1: We have taken technical and administrative security precautions to protect your personal data against loss, destruction, manipulation, and unauthorized access. All our employees and service providers working for us are bound by the applicable data protection laws.
privacy_sec_8_text_2: Whenever we collect and process personal data, it is encrypted before being transmitted. This means that your data cannot be misused by third parties. Our security measures are subject to a constant improvement process and our privacy policies are constantly revised. Please make sure that you have the latest version.
privacy_sec_9_text: No cookies are set by this app when you use it.
privacy_sec_10_title: What data protection rights do I have?
privacy_sec_10_intro: You have a right at all times to request info, rectification, erasure, or restriction of the processing of your stored data, a right to object to the processing, and a right to data portability and to complain in accordance with the requirements of data protection law.
privacy_sec_10_right_access_text: You can request confirmation from us as to whether and to what extent we process your data.
privacy_sec_10_right_rectification_text: If we process data that is incomplete or incorrect, you can request that it be corrected or completed by us at any time.
privacy_sec_10_right_erasure_text_1: You can request that we delete your data if we process it unlawfully or if the processing disproportionately interferes with your legitimate protection interests. Please note that there may be reasons preventing immediate deletion, e.g. in the case of statutory retention obligations.
privacy_sec_10_right_erasure_text_2: Regardless of the exercise of your right to deletion, we will delete your data promptly and completely, provided that there is no contractual or statutory obligation to retain it.
privacy_sec_10_right_restriction_intro: You can request us to restrict the processing of your data if:
privacy_sec_10_right_restriction_item_1: You dispute the accuracy of the data, for a period enabling us to verify the accuracy of the data.
privacy_sec_10_right_restriction_item_2: the processing is unlawful, but you oppose erasure and request restriction of data use instead,
privacy_sec_10_right_restriction_item_3: we no longer need the data for the intended purpose, but you still need it to assert or defend legal claims, or
privacy_sec_10_right_restriction_item_4: you have objected to the processing.
privacy_sec_10_right_object_text_1: If we process your data based on legitimate interest, you can object to this at any time; this would also apply to profiling based on these provisions. We will then no longer process your data unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds for processing that override your interests, rights, and freedoms or the processing serves to assert, exercise, or defend legal claims.
privacy_sec_10_right_object_text_2: You can object to the processing of your data for the purpose of direct marketing at any time without giving reasons.
privacy_sec_10_right_portability_intro: You can request us to provide you with the data you have provided to us in a structured, common, and machine-readable format and that you can transmit this data to another controller without hindrance from us, provided that:
privacy_sec_10_right_portability_item_1: we process this data based on consent given by you that can be revoked or to fulfill a contract between us, and
privacy_sec_10_right_portability_item_2: this processing is carried out using automated procedures.
privacy_sec_10_right_portability_text: If technically feasible, you can request us to transmit your data directly to another controller.
privacy_sec_10_right_complaint_text_1: If you believe that we violate German or European data protection law when processing your data, we ask you to contact us so that questions can be clarified. You of course also have the right to contact the supervisory authority responsible for you.
privacy_sec_10_right_complaint_text_2: If you want to assert one of the mentioned rights against us, please contact our data protection officer. In case of doubt, we may request additional information to confirm your identity.
privacy_sec_10_right_withdraw_text: If we process your data based on consent, you can withdraw it at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.
privacy_sec_10_right_automated_title: Automated decision-making in individual cases including profiling
privacy_sec_10_right_automated_text: You have the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing – including profiling – which produces legal effects concerning you or similarly significantly affects you. Exceptions to this only apply under the conditions of Art. 22 Para. 2 GDPR.
introduction_text: The protection of your personal data is of particular concern to us. We therefore process your data exclusively on the basis of legal provisions (GDPR, TDDDG). In these privacy information, we inform you about the most important aspects of data processing in the context of our website.
introduction_text_2: We ask you to read this privacy policy carefully. The protection of your personal data is of particular concern to us. We therefore process your data exclusively on the basis of legal provisions (GDPR, TDDDG). In these privacy information, we would like to inform you comprehensively about the most important aspects of data processing in the context of our website in accordance with Art. 13 of the European General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR).

section_3_text: The Mein Budget App stores all data exclusively on your device. No data is transmitted to external servers. Your financial data never leaves your device unless you explicitly use the export function.
section_4_text: We implement appropriate technical measures to protect your data. The app operates entirely offline and does not establish any network connections for data processing.
section_5_text: As a data subject, you have the following rights under Art. 15–22 EU GDPR:
right_to_restriction: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
right_to_object: Right to object to processing (Art. 21 GDPR)
rights_contact_text: To exercise these rights, please contact:
section_6_text: If you have questions about data processing or wish to exercise your rights, please contact the responsible party:
supervisory_authority_text: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.

waiting_for_key_delivery_description: The account owner will grant access shortly. You'll see the shared account appear once they do.
invite_accepted_description: You now have access to this account.
failed_to_accept_invite: Failed to accept invite. Please try again.
failed_to_decline_invite: Failed to decline invite. Please try again.
key_delivery_timeout: Timed out waiting for access. Please try again later.
access_granted_description: A shared account member now has access to your budget.
access_granted_description_plural: {{count}} members now have access to your shared budget.
delete_online_account_warning: This will permanently delete your online account and ALL associated data. This action cannot be undone!
delete_online_account_implications: All your accounts, transactions, and shared account memberships will be removed. If you own shared accounts, all members will lose access.
delete_online_account_success: Your account has been permanently deleted.
delete_online_account_failed: Failed to delete account. Please try again.
delete_online_account_offline: Cannot delete account while offline. Please connect to the internet and try again.
delete_online_account_recovery_failed: Account deleted but recovery data could not be removed. Please contact support.
delete_online_account_not_logged_in: You need to be logged in to delete your account.
delete_online_account_session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again and try deleting your account.
sync_wizard.preparing_note: If this is your first time installing the app, this will finish automatically. You do not need to do anything.
sync_wizard.importing_note: Please keep the app open. Your data stays on this device and will be available when this is finished.
onboarding_offline_body: After this onboarding, you can click Get started to use the app without registering. Registration is optional and only needed for online features such as sync, recovery, or sharing.
onboarding_registration_optional_note: Registration is optional. Click Get started to use the app locally on this device.
online_features_prompt_optional_body: If you do not register now, you can keep using your local accounts on this device. You can turn online features on later whenever you need them.
registration.signin_security_note: Your account is protected by a device key. If this is a new or replaced device, use Recover Account instead of normal sign-in.
registration.register_security_note: The new login creates a secure key for this device. After registering, save your recovery code so you can restore access if you lose this device or use another one.
migration.who_needs_this_title: Important for all users of the online function.
migration.who_needs_this_body: Only use this function if you used the online function in the previous version of your app. You log in to the app once using the same (old) credentials.
migration.offline_user_note: If you use the app offline only, you can go back and continue using your local accounts normally.
migration.credentials_security_note: These credentials are only used for this import. We do not store or keep them. The current app sign-in uses a more secure key-based login flow.
